notes: Hessdalen Valley Norway — 40yr instrumented study 188 sightings in one week 1984. VLF survey confirmed sulfide mineral deposit geometry. Best-studied analog site. RADAR confirmed.
Marfa Lights TX — Viewing platform established. Some events explained (car headlights). Unexplained subset documented on moonless nights predating highway. Mitchell Flat.
Brown Mountain Lights NC — Reports pre-1913 before automobile era. Multiple USGS investigations inconclusive. Linville Gorge fault zone proximity.

source: Yakima Lights WA / Greg Long research
notes: Yakima Lights WA — Research station 1970s-80s. Yakima Indian Reservation. Coincides with topographic saddle above fault system. Greg Long documented.
Min Min Lights Australia — Queensland outback persistent reports. Bioluminescence and refraction explanations proposed but disputed by long-distance reports.
Paulding Light MI — Largely explained as car headlight refraction on US-45. Retain in dataset flagged conventional.
Gurdon Light AR — Railroad ghost light. Some refraction explanation proposed. Persistent reports for 100+ years.
St. Louis Light Saskatchewan — CNR railway line. Multiple witnesses including RCMP. Refraction explanation proposed but witnesses describe light behavior inconsistent.
Monterey Bay CA persistent marine lights — USO-adjacent underwater light reports coinciding with Monterey Canyon submarine fault system.
Jemez Mountains NM — Persistent light phenomena near Los Alamos / Rio Grande Rift. Consistent with EQL mechanism.
